optimizedContext.value:
# Indexer

## Rules

- `IndexCodeGraph`: main write path for code graph indexing.
- Pipeline: discover workspaces and global resources; diff content hashes and derivation fingerprints; extract code/documents (Pass 1); resolve scoped bindings/relations (Pass 2); index specs via `SpecRepository` and `GetSpecMetadata`; bulk commit to `GraphStore`; persist `lastIndexedRef` and `IndexedInputObservation` records.
- Fingerprint diffing: matches running `@specd/code-graph` version plus canonical hash of resolved workspaces. Fingerprint or backend schema mismatch triggers destructive full rebuild via `recreate()` with reported reason (`fullRebuildReason`, `fullRebuild: boolean`).
- Workspace discovery: combines global `includePaths`/`excludePaths`, repository spec-root exclusions, workspace `allowedPaths`/`excludePaths`/`respectGitignore`. `specsPath` synthetically excluded from document discovery.
- File decoding: handles UTF-8, UTF-16LE, UTF-16BE, Windows-1252 (without NUL); filters binary extensions (`.gif`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.pdf`, `.zip`, etc.).
- `IndexSession` & 2-Pass extraction:
  1. Pass 1 (all workspaces/chunks): read files, generate adapter `FileAnalysis`, store `DEFINES`/`EXPORTS`.
  2. Pass 2 (after Pass 1 for all workspaces): resolve `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` deterministically from in-memory session facts. Self-relations and unresolved facts dropped. No store queries in Pass 2.
  3. Specs phase: list spec IDs via `repo.list()`; call `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })`; compare `metadataFingerprint`; load title/description (prefer `optimizedDescription`), `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL`, `DEPENDS_ON`.
  4. Single-session bulk commit: `GraphStore.bulkLoad()`; then `GraphStore.rebuildFtsIndexes()`.
- Cross-workspace package resolution: maps `packageName → workspaceName` via `LanguageAdapter.getPackageIdentity`.
- Progress & Error handling: `onProgress` callback reports phase percentages (0–100%); per-file extraction errors captured in `IndexResult.errors`; only infrastructure failures (disk full, store lost) abort run.
- `IndexResult`: contains `filesDiscovered`, `filesIndexed`, `filesRemoved`, `filesSkipped`, `specsDiscovered`, `specsIndexed`, `errors`, `duration`, per-workspace breakdowns, `vcsRef`, `graphFingerprint`, `fullRebuild`, `fullRebuildReason`.

## Constraints

- `GraphStore` must be open before running; indexer does not manage store lifecycle.
- Forward-slash relative paths; `excludePaths` replaces defaults when supplied; `.gitignore` absolute priority when `respectGitignore: true`.
- Pass 1 must finish for ALL workspaces before Pass 2 starts.
- Pass 2 binding environment uses in-memory pass facts only; no store queries, no language-specific rules in `IndexCodeGraph`, no self-relations.
- Specs indexed exclusively via `SpecRepository`.
